note: Cleveland NF campground in the Laguna Mountain Recreation Area off Sunrise Highway, among pines, oaks and a meadow, with the Pacific Crest and Big Laguna trails reachable from camp. Coin-operated showers. The Roadside loop is only for rigs 30 ft and longer; a 23-ft rig books the Shady, Meadow or Sunny loops. --Claude
summary: Laguna (Cleveland NF): open year-round (stored year_round false corrected; 25 sites close in winter), $35 + $10 extra vehicle confirmed, rec.gov reservable 14-night max, 72 sites in five loops (44 non-Roadside sites take 23 ft+, max 50), no hookups, flush toilets, coin showers, water. Note rewritten (the '~100+ sites' and 'reservable in season' claims were wrong). Website and phone suggested.
flags: SEASON: stored year_round false -> true. FS 'Open year round'; rec.gov sells 44 sites every winter night (25 Closed Dec-Apr).
SITE LENGTH: 44 sites outside the Roadside loop take 23 ft+; the 9-site Roadside loop is 'only for large rigs. RV'S MUST be 30 feet or LARGER', so it is closed to a 23-ft rig. Caveat in the note.
PHONE: empty -> 619-354-8776 (rec.gov 'call (619) 354-8776 to speak with local staff'; rec.gov facility_phone 619-473-2082 is the concessionaire).
PIN: stored 32.88800,-116.44700 is ~198 m from the catalog centroid 32.88716,-116.44887 - under 250 m, left.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (Little Laguna Lake is 'a short distance from the campground', a hiking destination; no shore sites).
LEADS: none. Burnt Rancheria (rec.gov 232278) is already in the database (12308); El Prado, Horse Heaven and Wooded Hill are group camps (out of scope).
